verdict.rationale: Whether a data platform's source is readable under an open license is a fair question for this product type, since open-source alternatives exist, so the axis applies. The evidence pack shows no open-source release of Snowflake's own code. The public snowflake-rest-api-specs repo contains API specifications rather than product source. Apache Iceberg support is an adjacent open-format feature, not open product source, so neither earns credit.
